title: KinderCare Awards $100,000 in Scholarships to Former Students Pursuing Two- or Four-year College, University or Vocational Program
summary: 20 former students receive scholarships to support college and future careers Key takeaways: KinderCare Learning Companies’ Kids Scholarship program is awarding $100,000 in scholarships to 20 former students of KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions and The Crème School for the 2026–27 school year. The KinderCare Kids Scholarship reflects the lasting impact of high-quality early childhood education, helping alumni build on the confidence, skills and love of learning developed during their formative years. Now in its seventh year, the KinderCare Kids Scholarship program has awarded more than $700,000 to help alumni continue their educational journeys. The scholarship program underscores KinderCare's belief that early learning creates a strong foundation for lifelong learning, achievement and opportunity. KinderCare Learning Companies, Inc.
